note: Forest Service campground in the Current River bottoms north of Doniphan, beside the Float Camp day-use area: a large, open campground of level, roomy sites with little screening between them. The half-mile Woodchuck Trail links it to the picnic area by the river. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the FS page: 21 sites (7 electric), RVs to 40 ft, $15 / $25 electric / $35 double, fee tube. Changed: booking -> not reservable, fcfs always (rec.gov lists only the group picnic pavilion); season 04-01..10-31 (approx) -> 04-01..10-01; fees high 25 -> base 15 + electric surcharge $10; sites count 21; facilities + vault toilets, no dump; senior/access 50% written. Amperage not stated (stored 50 left, flagged). PIN in woods 55 m SE of the pads -> 36.6652,-90.8715. Waterfront riverview -> not waterfront proposed.
flags: BOOKING: recreation.gov's only Float Camp facility is 232418 'FLOAT CAMP PICNIC AREA', whose catalog is one GROUP PICNIC AREA day-use site ($50 group rate); the FS page says 'Reservation needed for Group Picnic Pavilion' and 'Campground: Fees will be paid at the fee tube provided'. Written reservable false, fcfs always. The entry's website still lists https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/232418, which books the picnic pavilion, not the campground: suggest removing that line (website is not a group, not written).

HOOKUPS (not written): FS page 'Electrical hook ups are available at some campsites' (4 single + 3 double electric), 'no individual water hookup available', 'No sewage hookups or dump stations'. No amperage anywhere. Stored electric 50 is derived from old sweep note prose ('some 30/50A'), which the new note drops; it stays until a page states the amps. water/sewer false are stated, but writing the group would stamp the unverified 50 as manual, so left.

WATER CONFLICT: the FS page says potable pressurized water (faucets) is available; recreation.gov's picnic-area listing carries the undated notice 'Drinking water is not availalbe at the campground'. potable_water true written from the FS campground page; AWH may prefer rec.gov's notice (trust-rec.gov rule), in which case set potable_water null.
STATUS: the FS page header shows 'Site Closed' (2026-11-09) - consistent with the season ending October 1; no closure notice beyond the season. Not recorded as a status.

PIN: stored 36.6647,-90.8714 = recreation.gov's picnic-area point, in woods ~55 m SE of the developed loop. Imagery shows ~10 rectangular gravel pull-in pads on a loop road at 36.6652,-90.8715, with the road continuing ~250 m NW along the river to a second group of pads (36.6664,-90.8738). FS lat/long 36.66559,-90.87247 sits between them. Move the pin onto the pads at 36.6652,-90.8715. Which end is the picnic area and which the campground is not certain from imagery; the loop of pads looks like campsites.

WATERFRONT (riverview -> not waterfront proposed): the pad loop is ~95-125 m from the Current River's water through woods and a sand beach; the NW pads are ~50-60 m from a side channel through trees. The '150 feet from the river' figure on both pages is the PICNIC AREA's, not the campground's. No source says the campsites see the river and imagery cannot confirm a view under leaf-on canopy; unsure -> downgrade (AWH 2026-11-02). Keep riverview only if a photo shows the river from the sites.
FIT: RVs up to 40 ft, asphalt parking, no clearance restriction; FR 3210 off Highway Y. No 4WD/ford wording.
PHONE: none stored; the FS page gives the Eleven Point/Doniphan Ranger District '573-996-2153' (phone is not a group; add it if wanted).
